نستقض (form X)
# نَسْتَقْضِ (nastaqḍi) /nas.taq.dˤi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# نُسْتَقْضَ (nustaqḍa) /nus.taq.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
